description: Plaud ingest workflow aborted at step-01: Plaud API requires authentication token obtained via interactive Chrome login flow. Non-interactive sandbox environment cannot complete browser-based auth or access host filesystem (~/.config/plaud/).
correction: Plaud API token must be cached by running Chrome login flow (https://web.plaud.ai) on the user's Mac to extract JWT from localStorage and write to ~/.config/plaud/token.json. This requires interactive authentication — it cannot be completed in a sandbox.
systemic_fix: Plaud discovery should either: (1) be run only in interactive/host contexts, or (2) detect missing token and gracefully prompt for user action rather than silently failing. Current architecture assumes fetch_plaud.py will be executed on the Mac, but workflow routing does not enforce this.
